scripts.build: cross-env bun run copy:frontend && go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o bin/webrtc-server
scripts.build:win:amd64: cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 bun run build -- -o bin/windows_amd64/webrtc-server.exe
scripts.build:win:arm64: cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 bun run build -- -o bin/windows_arm64/webrtc-server.exe
scripts.build:linux:amd64: cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 bun run build -- -o bin/linux_amd64/webrtc-server
scripts.build:linux:arm64: cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 bun run build -- -o bin/linux_arm64/webrtc-server
scripts.build:mac:amd64: cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 bun run build -- -o bin/mac_amd64/webrtc-server
scripts.build:mac:arm64: cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 bun run build -- -o bin/mac_arm64/webrtc-server
scripts.build:all: bun run clean && bun run build:win:amd64 && bun run build:win:arm64 && bun run build:linux:amd64 && bun run build:linux:arm64 && bun run build:mac:amd64 && bun run build:mac:arm64
